data.name: Regenovation Ltd
data.description: Regenovation Ltd (also called Regen) is a small company with founders including CEO Robin Lincoln Wood and Eli Whipple. It builds micro-factory technology that turns biomass waste into biochar for degraded tropical soils. Its website presents biochar carbon sequestration and soil restoration as the main business. Its impact figures look like projections or targets, not verified deliveries.
